# Lattice - All-in-One Platform for Contractors

> The #1 AI-Powered Contractor Management Platform in the United States

## Overview

Lattice is the leading all-in-one platform for contractors, remodelers, and construction businesses across the United States. We provide AI-powered CRM, 3D rendering, design tools, and free professional websites to help contractors grow their businesses nationwide.

## Coverage

- **Service Area**: All 50 states across the United States
- **Availability**: Nationwide coverage from coast to coast
- **Support**: US-based customer support team
- **Market Position**: #1 comprehensive contractor platform in America

## Core Services

### 1. LatticeAI CRM (Free)
The most advanced CRM built specifically for contractors in the United States.

**Features**:
- AI-powered lead management and automation
- Smart lead scoring and distribution
- Automated follow-up sequences (email, SMS, calls)
- Project tracking from consultation to completion
- Machine learning for project decisions
- AI-driven customer communication (24/7)
- Automated invoicing and payment tracking
- Revenue forecasting and analytics
- On-site voice-to-CRM sync
- Integration with QuickBooks, Gmail, and calendars

**Best For**: Contractors, remodelers, home builders, construction businesses across all US states

**Pricing**: FREE (includes CRM + professional website)

### 2. 3D Rendering Services
Professional photorealistic 3D visualizations for renovation and construction projects.

**Features**:
- Photorealistic room and space rendering
- Before/after visualizations
- Multiple design variations
- Client presentation tools
- Virtual walkthroughs
- Material and finish previews
- Lighting simulations
- Architectural visualization

**Benefits**: Close deals 3x faster, increase conversion rates by 45%, help clients visualize projects before construction

**Availability**: Nationwide service across all US markets

### 3. AI Designer - Instant Room Redesign
Revolutionary AI-powered interior design tool for instant room transformations.

**Features**:
- AI-generated room design variations in seconds
- Multiple style options (modern, traditional, contemporary, rustic, etc.)
- Instant furniture and decor recommendations
- Color scheme suggestions
- Layout optimization
- Material and finish exploration
- Real-time client collaboration
- Mobile-friendly design interface

**Use Cases**: Kitchen remodels, bathroom renovations, living spaces, commercial interiors, whole-home redesigns

**Speed**: Generate 10+ design variations in under 60 seconds

### 4. Digital Showroom
Interactive portfolio platform to showcase your best work.

**Features**:
- 3D project tours and virtual walkthroughs
- Before/after galleries with slider comparisons
- Client testimonials and reviews
- Project categorization (kitchens, bathrooms, additions, etc.)
- Mobile-responsive showcase
- Lead capture integration
- Social sharing capabilities
- SEO-optimized portfolio pages

**Results**: 45% increase in conversion rates, professional brand presence, 24/7 portfolio access

### 5. SEO Web Design (Free with Platform)
Free professional website for contractors with built-in SEO optimization.

**Features**:
- Mobile-responsive modern design
- Local SEO optimization for all US cities
- Google My Business integration
- Lead capture forms and CTAs
- Fast loading speeds (Next.js powered)
- Contact forms with SMS/email notifications
- Service pages and portfolio integration
- Blog and resources section
- SSL security included
- Automatic sitemap generation

**SEO Benefits**: Rank for "[your service] near me" in your local market, Google Maps visibility, organic lead generation

**Setup Time**: Website live in 24-48 hours

### 6. Remote Employees
Scale your contractor business with skilled remote staff.

**Services**:
- Remote interior designers
- Project coordinators
- Accounting and bookkeeping staff
- Customer service representatives
- CAD drafters and 3D modelers
- Marketing specialists
- Administrative assistants

**Benefits**: 60-70% cost savings vs. local hiring, US timezone coverage, vetted professionals, scalable staffing
